result.instructions: Tools for TrekkSoft, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tours have free seats next weekend?"; "Show all bookings made yesterday and the guests on each."; "List the guests on tomorrow's 09:00 departure with their phone numbers.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TrekkSoft data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run trekksoft_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run trekksoft_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run trekksoft_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. trekksoft_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: trekksoft_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List the tours and activities of your TrekkSoft account, with filters for merchant, category, title, active and bookable state. TrekkSoft API: GET /activities.

merchant.description: Only activities of these merchant codes.

language.description: Language code such as en, de, fr (default en).

tools.name: trekksoft_get_activity
tools.title: Get an activity
tools.description: Get one activity by id: description, schedule, price categories and settings. TrekkSoft API: GET /activities/{activityId}.

language.description: Language code such as en, de, fr (default en).

tools.name: trekksoft_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List recent bookings. Filter by merchant, user email, free text, booking date, activity date, or changes since a time. TrekkSoft API: GET /bookings.

merchant.description: Only bookings sold by these merchant codes.

user.description: Only bookings of these user emails.

q.description: Free text: booking id, guest name or email, activity name, booking number.

changed_after.description: ISO 8601 time: only bookings changed after it.

booked_after.description: ISO 8601 time: only bookings made after it.

cancelled_after.description: ISO 8601 time: only bookings cancelled after it.

tools.name: trekksoft_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: activity, guests, prices, payments and status. TrekkSoft API: GET /bookings/{id}.

tools.name: trekksoft_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List guests (participants) with filters for booking, trip departure, phone, name and cancellation. TrekkSoft API: GET /guests.

availability_item_id.description: Only guests of these departures (availability item ids).

cancelled_after.description: ISO 8601 time: only guests cancelled after it.

tools.name: trekksoft_get_guest
tools.title: Get a guest
tools.description: Get one guest by id, including booking link and check-in state. TrekkSoft API: GET /guest/{id}.

tools.name: trekksoft_list_availabilities
tools.title: List availabilities
tools.description: List departures with free seats across activities, for a date range. TrekkSoft API: GET /availabilities.

language.description: Language code such as en, de, fr (default en).

tools.name: trekksoft_list_activity_availabilities
tools.title: List availabilities of one activity
tools.description: List departures with free seats for one activity. TrekkSoft API: GET /activities/{activityId}/availabilities.

language.description: Language code such as en, de, fr (default en).

tools.name: trekksoft_list_merchants
tools.title: List merchants
tools.description: List the merchants your key pair can access. TrekkSoft API: GET /merchants.

language.description: Language code such as en, de, fr (default en).

tools.name: trekksoft_list_shop_items
tools.title: List shop items
tools.description: List shop items (extras sold with activities), filterable by merchant, category and active state. TrekkSoft API: GET /shop/items.

merchant_id.description: Only items of these merchant ids.

category_id.description: Only items of these category ids.

language.description: Language code such as en, de, fr (default en).
